scope: Final public tasks/configuration, source-derived oracles, mutation provenance and materialized worker inputs for axi_review and idma_review.
source_review: Each case has three independently source-grounded local findings: two semantic/interface errors and one explicit integration-contract violation. The recorded patches and hashes reproduce exactly the intended changes; no unrecorded RTL changes were found.
task_review: Both prose tasks omit finding counts, defect locations and an enumerated defect-category checklist. Requirements and interface-preserving corrections are clear. The IDMA flush wording now permits ordinary enabled writes while requiring that flush itself not clear storage, including the explicit no-transfer preservation invariant.
boundary_review: Both intentionally unavailable monitor definitions remain separate external boundaries. Local findings do not depend on inventing monitor behavior or a replacement implementation; complete integration sign-off remains conditional.
grading_review: Each oracle has eight source-based criteria covering findings, explanations, repairs and calibrated disposition. Equivalent prose and symbol/hierarchy references are accepted; no MCP-only facts, tool-name bonus or compiler-diagnostic-string match is required.
configuration_review: config.json and its top_module/include_directories keys now match the unchanged skill contract. Selected tops, include-directory values, COMMON_CELLS_ASSERTS_OFF and single_unit=true are unchanged. The revision changes public task precision and configuration naming only; RTL, oracle content and effective compiler configuration remain unchanged.

input_review.checks: Final workspace manifests match every file in durable and materialized inputs, including hidden dependencies, with no extra files or symlinks. Runtime files are read-only. No corpus oracles, patches, provenance reports, compiler validation, proofs or controller review artifacts are present in worker inputs. Source selection remains the worker's choice.
